This sits directly at odds with promoter-level H3K4me3 still elevated at 7 d in oysters and with 5-month functional protection in oysters, implying bulk histone marks are not the memory substrate

Species caveat - Eriocheir sinensis is a catadromous, estuarine-breeding crab usually cultured in fresh water, so it sits at the edge of the marine/estuarine inclusion criterion; flagged rather than excluded
